def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate the 8-bit value x left by k bits, wrapping the high bits to the low end. k is in 0..7."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    post out >= 0 and out <= 255
    ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
    ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
    ex rotl8(90, 0) == 90
    high = x >> 1 >> (7 - k)
    low = (x & (255 >> k)) << k
    return high | low
